༄༅/ /mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i zab gter drag po dbu dgu'i gter srung ma ning sde brgyad dang brtan ma'i mchod phrin bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i zab gter drag po dbu dgu'i gter srung ma ning sde brgyad dang brtan ma'i mchod phrin bzhugs so//

bka' srung gsang ba'i yang tig bzhugs so: yang gsang bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bla med yang gsang rgyud kyi bka' srung gi: sgrub thabs yang snying gsang ba snying gi bcud: phyi rabs las can skal ldan don du bzhag: dur khrod la sogs dben pa'i sa phyogs su: phyi nang gsang ba don gyi rten dang bcas: sman raka gtor ma mchod tshogs tshul bzhin bsham: bdag nyid dpal ldan rdo rje drag po rtsal: gsal bsgom ngang nas rdzogs rim bzlas pa bya: mdun du dur khrod che chung e dbus su: dgra bgegs gdan steng hūm̐ las dpal chen po: khro rgyal ma ning nag po ha la'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: tsan+dan bing chen rked btsugs dar nag gsol: gser ska rin chen rgyan ldan dur khrod chas: mdun du bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo nag: bong bu drel zhon ral gri ne'u le 'dzin: re lde'i smad sham til mar sku lus khyab: lan bu g.yon 'phyang snyan gong seng sbrul 'phyo: nyi zla lus 'char ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: hūm̐ bh+yo'i sgra sgrog sde brgyad dregs pas bskor: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs dkyil nas: sangs rgyas bstan srung mgon po 'khor dang bcas: ma mgon sde brgyad sprul pa'i dmag tshogs rnams: u tsa la dang bsil ba tshal chen po: ma la ya dang ha ha rgod pa nas: rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol: gtsug lag khang dang dur khrod pho brang 'dir: brtan par bzhugs la zhal ston phrin las mdzod: phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa'i tshogs: legs par sbyar ba phyi nang rgya mtsho'i sprin: nam mkha' gang bar byin gyis brlabs nas kyang: che mchog thugs sprul mgon po'i thugs dam bskang: 'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo'i thugs dam bskang: phyi nang gsang ba drag po rtag chags kyi: sde brgyad dregs pa pho mo'i thugs dam bskang: nag po stong dang bdud po khri yi tshogs: sha za 'bum sde ma mo bye ba'i tshogs:

sprul pa dung phyur rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: mchod bzhes dam bskang phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la re ma ti a ya ma du ru tsa sha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma hā pañtsa ba liṃ ta rak+ta pi pa hoḥ puṣ+paṃ: dhū paṃ: dī paṃ: gan+dhaṃ: nai bid+yaṃ: shab+da pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa khā hi: 'di kho nas phrin las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro: yang gsang bla med don gyi bka' srung 'di: snying gi bu mchog gcig dang 'phrad par shog: s+ya/mya/y+ya/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: 'di'i bka' 'di sbyin par 'dod na: sgrub gtor lhar bskyed slob bu khrus bya: yon 'bul: lha bskyed bstim bya'o: bla med yang gsang yang tig la: lo rgyus lung bstan bskyed rdzogs kyi: rtsa ba dbang bskur cho 'phrul dang: gnad them bcas pa brgya rtsa brgyad: pad+ma rgyal pos them du bstan: gang du'ang btsal bas mi rnyed kyi: las can bu yi dpal du shog: bka' srung gnyan gyis bya ra mdzod: dus mthar pad+ma rgyal po rtsal: ye shes rig pa rang gsal dang: 'di 'phrad 'gro ba'i dpal du shog: s+ya/mya/y+ya/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: kha tham: ༈ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi dang: dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi dang: dkar sham bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi dang: bod khams skyong bar khas blangs dam bcas pa rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa ni: rin po che'i snod du bshos bu gru bzhi bzhi dang: gru gsum bzhi: sman bshos bzhi ste: rgyan dang ldan pa bcu gnyis bsham: gzhan yang sman raka la sogs mchod yon dang spyan gzigs bshams la: rang yi dam du skad cig gis bskyed: sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa spyan drangs la 'di skad do: hūm̐ bh+yo: sbrags kyi yang rdzong zhes bya'i gnas mchog nas:

bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: sku mdog sngon mo chibs su rta nag bcibs: mi lpags gyon nas phyag na khram bam phyar: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: lho bal mtshams zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog nas: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong: sku mdog dkar mo chibs su seng ge bcibs: dar dkar gyon zhing gser gyi rdo rje bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: gangs kyi brin zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog nas: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang: sku mdog dkar mo chibs su gtsos pho bcibs: ras gos gyon nas gser gyi phyag shing bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: 'brog gi do nag zhes bya'i gnas mchog nas: 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: sku mdog dkar mo za le 'bri la zhon: ro thul gyon zhing dung gi tshugs shing bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: jo mo gangs zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog nas: gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma: sku mdog dkar mo gnyan mdzo dkar mo zhon: gtsod kyi pags gyon g.yu 'brug zhags pa bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: rong gi kha rag zhes bya'i gnas mchog nas: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: sku mdog dmar mo bong bu rog po zhon: dar nag gyon nas bdud kyi khram shing bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: rma chen spom ra zhes bya'i gnas mchog nas: rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal:

sku mdog dmar mo gnyan pho rwa can zhon: chu srin g.yang gzhi gyon zhing sbal pa bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: bo dong nags rgyal zhes bya'i gnas mchog nas: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo ste: sku mdog ser mo rkyang bu kha dkar zhon: sram thul gyon zhing phyag na gser mda' bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: kong yul zhes bya bres sna'i gnas mchog nas: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong: sku mdog smug po bong drel gwa pa zhon: dar nag gyon zhing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: sman gcig phur thang zhes bya'i gnas mchog nas: btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma: sku mdog dkar mo sha ba yu mo bcibs: dar dkar gyon zhing phyag na mda' dar bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: g.yar mo thang zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog nas: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo skyong: sku mdog dmar skya rnga mo gwa pa zhon: gang ral gyon zhing ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: bod yul ting shos ti rtsi'i gnas mchog nas: g.yu yi dril snyan rdo rje gzugs legs ma: sku mdog ljang gu g.yu 'brug sngon po zhon: dar sngon gsol nas rin chen sgrom bu bsnams: 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: bod yul brtan ma bcu gnyis khyod: bal yul shod kyi gting zhig tu: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:

zhing chen bsgyel ba'i gdan steng du: rnam lnga zhing gi tshogs gral du: lag tu rdo rje gtad nas kyang: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gral du bzhag: thar pa thob par lung yang bstan: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: re ba thams cad skong ba dang: bsam pa thams cad bsgrub bo zhes: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ces pas gtor ma gtang ngo: badz+ra gats+tshaḥ sa mgron rnams so so'i bran g.yog dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rang rang gi gnas la gshegs par bsam: dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo'o: brtan ma'i gtor 'bul slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad nas: dag pa'i 'khor lnga la gdams pa rdzogs so: yang gter snying po'i gter srung du byon pa'o:
